pca: abbr. 汙染控制局（Pollution Control Agency）；極地冷空氣堆吸收, 極冠吸收（Polar Cap Absorption）；波特蘭水泥協會（Portland Cement Association）
pcp: abbr. 五氯苯酚（pentachlorophenol, 一種迷幻藥）；苯環己哌啶（phencyclidine, 等於angel dust, 醫用麻醉藥）；主控程式（Primary Control Program）

n a person who helps in identifying or preventing or treating illness or disability
n a drug used as an anesthetic by veterinarians; illicitly taken (originally in the form of powder or `dust') for its effects as a hallucinogen
pcr: abbr. 光電導繼電器（Photo-conductive Relay）；程式控制暫存器（program control register）
